reuse.why: Reuses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, and shares validation and local unlinking across all providers.

duplication.why: Fintegra copies the existing linking lifecycle and transaction downloader, while six handlers repeat the validation-and-conditional-unlink sequence.

placement.why: Link orchestration, transaction downloading, server configuration and provider types follow the tree's existing module boundaries.

scope.why: All changes directly support the requested linking rules, takeover option and server-side Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Centralized validation and unlinking help maintenance, but another copied provider lifecycle and repeated takeover orchestration increase the places future changes must touch.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers use assertCanLinkBankAccount and findOrCreateBank, and both takeover and account-unlink use clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount reproduces the existing provider linking lifecycle under new provider names, and downloadFintegraTransactions reproduces the existing authenticated transaction download and response normalization.

abstraction_drift.where: assertCanLinkBankAccount expands the duplicate-link guard with closed-target rejection and a replaceExistingLink option controlling duplicate rejection; all six providers continue through the shared guard.
